communication_style.clarification_preference: Ask when a trade-off affects arrival reliability, connection comfort, or meal logistics; otherwise make a practical shortlist.
planning_behavior: Provides dates, city pairs, event times, and hotel-area constraints early.
Likes short comparison tables with trade-offs called out plainly.
Appreciates notes about uncertainty, especially for flight connections, hotel food access, and room details.
Will ask for one focused revision rather than exploring many speculative options.

habit_interactions.interaction: Her morning campus or school commitments make afternoon departures show up often, but fixed event times can override that timing pattern.
The soft Delta preference is most useful from Salt Lake City, but it should not crowd out connection quality when secondary-market routes require a transfer.
Hotel breakfast and restaurant access reflect the same recurring need for easy meals around early school visits, evening fairs, and late arrivals.
Window seats and queen-bed room setups are comfort defaults that appear in booking details but rarely determine the overall destination or schedule.

habits.boundary_condition: This is a soft preference: Delta is favored only among otherwise suitable options and may coexist with other acceptable preferred carriers.
habits.condition: When choosing among flight carriers and Delta is available while also satisfying the trip's schedule, route, price, and stop constraints.
habits.default_action: Search for or present Delta options as part of the preferred carrier set, and favor Delta when it is otherwise comparable to alternatives.
habits.exception_condition: Use another acceptable carrier when Delta is unavailable, materially worse, or does not meet the current trip constraints.
habits.name: soft_delta_preferred_carrier
habits.preference_value: Delta is a preferred airline to include in the flight shortlist, but not an exclusive carrier requirement.
habits.scope_condition: Applies to her self-booked U.S. flights from Salt Lake City for recruitment loops, conferences, and occasional family trips.

habits.boundary_condition: Applies only to flight departure time-of-day. Do not infer it for arrival times, dates, routes, every leg automatically, or earliest-afternoon departures as a recurring rule.
habits.condition: When selecting or comparing flight departure times.
habits.default_action: Look first for departure options in the afternoon; follow any current explicit request for another time window or exact time.
habits.exception_condition: If acceptable afternoon departures are unavailable or conflict with other stated constraints, ask before broadening to nearby time windows.
habits.name: prefers_afternoon_departures
habits.preference_value: Prefers flight departures in the afternoon when no different departure-time constraint is specified.
habits.scope_condition: Applies when choosing flight departure times for trips without a fixed competing time constraint, especially after morning school visits, campus meetings, or office handoffs.

habits.boundary_condition: Do not infer that the user always wants nonstop first, wants a layover for price reasons, or wants to add a stop to break up a long route unless the current request says so.
habits.condition: When evaluating flight itineraries where a connection is acceptable, necessary, or being considered.
habits.default_action: Favor itineraries with at most one short layover; ask before selecting itineraries with multiple layovers or a long layover.
habits.exception_condition: Override this default if the user explicitly requests nonstop only, requests a longer stopover, or prioritizes schedule, availability, price, or another constraint over layover count or layover duration.
habits.name: flight_single_short_layover_preference
habits.preference_value: Prefers connecting itineraries with no more than one layover, and for any layover to be short enough for a comfortable transfer rather than prolonged.
habits.scope_condition: Applies to domestic itineraries where a connection is being considered, especially routes from Salt Lake City to smaller recruitment or conference markets.

habits.boundary_condition: Applies only to seat location. If seat selection is unavailable at booking or is deferred until check-in, note that limitation and try to secure a window seat at the earliest available time.
habits.condition: When booking or selecting seats for flights where a seat location preference can be applied.
habits.default_action: Prefer or request a window seat by default.
habits.exception_condition: Use a different seat only if the user specifies another seat preference, needs a different seating arrangement, or no acceptable window seat is available.
habits.name: prefers_window_seat_on_flights
habits.scope_condition: Applies to seat selection on flights she books for herself, including solo work trips and occasional family travel.

habits.boundary_condition: Use this as a soft preference, not an absolute requirement, because the evidence ranges from a direct requirement to a tentative request and a later verification question.
habits.condition: When evaluating or booking a hotel, treat free breakfast as a recurring included-service preference.
habits.default_action: Prioritize or verify hotels with free breakfast when available; if breakfast is not listed, ask or check rather than assuming it is included.
habits.exception_condition: Do not reject an otherwise suitable hotel solely for lacking free breakfast unless the user explicitly makes it required in the current booking; do not infer a full or high-quality breakfast requirement unless stated.
habits.name: prefer_included_hotel_breakfast
habits.preference_value: Prefer hotels that include free breakfast.
habits.scope_condition: Applies to hotels for early-start recruitment, conference, and short family stays where breakfast logistics are part of the comparison.

habits.boundary_condition: Do not infer specific cuisine, star rating, bar service, kid-friendliness, downtown location, ski access, or wooded setting unless stated for the current trip.
habits.condition: When searching for, comparing, or summarizing hotel options.
habits.default_action: Mention on-site or nearby restaurant availability and use convenient dining access as a soft tie-breaker rather than a hard filter.
habits.exception_condition: Do not apply if the user explicitly deprioritizes dining access or if stronger current-trip constraints override it.
habits.name: hotel_restaurant_access
habits.preference_value: Hotels with on-site or nearby restaurant access, with restaurant availability noted during comparisons.
habits.scope_condition: Applies to hotels after evening fairs, receptions, late arrivals, or suburban venue stays where convenient dinner access matters.

habits.boundary_condition: Evidence supports queen-size beds as the recurring preference. A king bed may be acceptable when explicitly offered or requested, but the evidence does not establish a reusable preference to upgrade to king whenever possible.
habits.condition: When booking a standard hotel room where a single larger/shared bed is appropriate and no separate-bed setup has been requested.
habits.default_action: Filter for or request a queen-size bed when bed type is selectable; if the listing only shows double, twin, or unspecified bedding, confirm the bed setup before booking.
habits.exception_condition: Honor explicit requests for twin beds, multiple separate beds, multiple rooms with different bedding, accessibility-related bedding, or any other trip-specific bed arrangement.
habits.name: queen_bed_for_single_bed_hotel_rooms
habits.preference_value: Prefer a queen-size bed for hotel rooms intended to have one larger/shared bed.
habits.scope_condition: Applies to standard hotel rooms for solo work travel or spouse/family weekend stays when a single larger-bed room is the appropriate setup.

longitudinal_plan.travel_tempo: Roughly two academic-year cycles, with dense fall recruitment periods, a smaller spring event wave, a few summer conferences, and scattered personal weekends. Expect about 24 to 30 distinct trip-planning episodes spread across the sessions.

typical_episode_shape.conference_trip: Block hotel comparison, flight timing check, and one follow-up to reconcile reimbursement or agenda constraints.
typical_episode_shape.personal_weekend: Shorter planning thread with flights and a practical hotel, usually reusing comfort defaults without extensive optimization.
typical_episode_shape.work_trip: Initial route and hotel search, refinement around event times, final shortlist or booking summary, and occasional change handling when fair schedules move.

persona.decision_posture: Organized, schedule-aware, and practical. She values predictable flights and easy food logistics more than luxury, and treats most preferences as soft when fair times, campus events, availability, or reimbursement rules dominate.
persona.name: Tessa Alvarez
persona.occupation: regional admissions recruiter for a private university
persona.travel_identity: Seasonal self-booking traveler who plans recruitment loops, admitted-student receptions, higher-ed conferences, and occasional family weekends.

travel_contexts.description: August through November trips to high-school visits, college fairs, and counselor breakfasts across the Mountain West, Pacific Northwest, Texas, and upper Midwest.
travel_contexts.planning_notes: Often multi-city, with morning school appointments and evening fair commitments.

travel_contexts.description: February through April travel for admitted-student receptions, transfer fairs, alumni-hosted meetups, and counselor follow-ups.
travel_contexts.planning_notes: More date-constrained than fall travel, with hotels often near suburban event venues.

travel_contexts.description: A few annual higher-education and admissions conferences, sometimes involving conference hotel blocks and tighter flight windows.
travel_contexts.planning_notes: She compares official blocks against nearby practical alternatives.

travel_contexts.description: Occasional trips with her spouse or one of her teenagers to visit relatives, attend tournaments, or add a short leisure weekend after work travel.
travel_contexts.planning_notes: These are less frequent but reuse many of her comfort defaults.
